newsitem.title: USA: SMT Health says not named in Northstar suit.
newsitem.headline: SMT Health says not named in Northstar suit.

text.p: SMT Health Services Inc said Tuesday a suit filed against its chairman and chief executive officer was made against him as a person and not as representative of the company, and SMT was not named in the suit.
SMT, which offers diagnostic imaging services to healthcare providers, said Northstar Health Services Inc had named Jeff Bergman individually as a defendant in a civil lawsuit.

"The company is not named as a defendant and ...the allegations made in the lawsuit do not in any regard relate to SMT nor to Mr. Bergman in his capacity as chairman, CEO and president of SMT," it said.
A spokeswoman for Northstar said Bergman was identified in the lawsuit as a friend and business associate of Mark deSimone, its former chief executive officer.
Northwest has filed a suit against deSimone for allegedly diverting and misappropriating millions of dollars.
